   - `git diff --stat 2d7fb57..HEAD -- client/src server/src` → empty

3. **Updated** `overnight_resume.md` (new s2-frontend entry) and `MEMORY.md` pointer.

### No code changes
Nothing was broken, so nothing was fixed — the charter forbids touching working features. The two remaining known gaps (Esc-to-close keyboard nav; EstimateBuilder at 375px) are both explicitly out-of-charter (enhancement / mobile-paused). The two untracked `claude-overnight-*.json` files predate this run.

**Recommendation for next run:** don't re-sweep — the app is converged on every axis. Only re-test if `git diff --stat 2d7fb57..HEAD -- client/src server/src` becomes non-empty.
